module comparator_4bit(input [3:0] a, input [3:0] b, output gt, eq, lt);

wire n1, n2, n3, n4, n5, n6, n7, n8, n9, n10;
wire n11, n12, n13, n14, n15, n16, n17, n18, n19, n20;
wire n21, n22, n23, n24, n25, n26, n27, n28, n29;

// Top section
assign n1  = ~(b[3] | b[2]);                 // NOR
assign n2  = ~(b[3] ^ b[2]);                 // XNOR
assign n3  = ~(a[3] | b[2]);                 // NOR
assign n4  = ~(n2 & n3);                             // NAND
assign n5  = ~(n1 & n4);                             // NAND

assign n6  = (b[2] ^ a[1]);                  // XOR
assign n7  = ~(n6 & n3);                             // NAND

// Middle/lower-left section
assign n8  = ~(a[1] | a[0]);                 // NOR
assign n9  = (b[1] ^ a[0]);                  // XOR
assign n10 = ~(n8 & n9);                             // NAND

assign n11 = ~(b[1] | a[1]);                 // NOR
assign n12 = ~(n11 & n9);                            // NAND

// Center/lower section
assign n13 = ~(b[1] | n12);                      // NOR
assign n14 = ~(n10 & n13);                           // NAND

assign n15 = (n12 ^ n9);                             // XOR
assign n16 = (n15 | a[0]);                       // OR
assign n17 = ~(n16 & n15);                           // NAND

// Right section
assign n18 = ~(n14 & n7);                            // NAND
assign n19 = ~(n18 & n5);                            // NAND

assign n20 = ~(n14 & n17);                           // NAND

assign n21 = ~(n19 & n20);                           // NAND
assign n22 = ~n21;                                   // inverter-equivalent via output split

assign n23 = ~(n20 & n20);                           // inverter-equivalent
assign n24 = ~(n23 & n23);                           // restore

assign lt = n22;
assign gt = ~(n21 | n21);                         // NOR with tied inputs = inversion
assign eq = n20;

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input p1a,
  input p1b,
  input p1c,
  input p1d,
  output p1y,
  input p2a,
  input p2b,
  input p2c,
  input p2d,
  output p2y
);

  assign p1y = ~(((p1b & p1a) & p1c) & p1d);
  assign p2y = ~(((p2b & p2a) & p2c) & p2d);

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [3:0] a,
  input [3:0] b,
  input [3:0] c,
  input [3:0] d,
  input [3:0] e,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

always @* begin
  q = a ^ b ^ c ^ d ^ e;
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input a,
  input b,
  input c,
  input d,
  output reg out
);

always @(*) begin
  out = ~(c & b) | a;
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input a,
  input b,
  input c,
  input d,
  output reg out
);

always @(*) begin
  out = ~(d ^ c) ^ ~(b ^ a);
end

endmodule
